title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Service Rules: Conditions for Requesting a Light
content:
**Area and Security Lighting Rental — conditions for a light request.**

1. A light is requested only for a fixture that is installed new, billed on a service account whose rate schedule is one of the rate schedules a light may be billed on.
2. A light may be requested only on a service account in active or idle status.
3. A light is rented only to a member whose member type is one of the member types that may rent a light.
4. Where the product requires an active billing service account, which it does for every fixture, the billing account must be open.

## The conditions read one at a time

| Condition | What is looked at | Where it is shown |
|---|---|---|
| Fixture | Whether the requested fixture is installed new. The LED 40W Security Light, LED 70W Area Light, LED 110W Flood Light and LED 150W Flood Light are; the legacy HPS 100W Security Light, HPS 250W Flood Light and Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light are not, and are never requested. | The fixture named on the request |
| Rate schedule | The rate schedule of the service account the light is to be billed on | The cooperative's service account record |
| Service account status | The status of that same service account, at the time of the request | The cooperative's service account record |
| Member type | The member type of the member renting the light | The member's record |

The account status is the system record of the very service account the light is to be billed on. What the member says about an account's status is not the evidence, and the status of another account the member holds does not decide it.

## Status of the billing service account

| Billing service account status at the request | May a light be requested on it? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Idle | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service cabin account sits idle for the winter. A request for an LED 40W Security Light billed on it meets the status condition, because an idle account is one of the two statuses on which a light may be requested.
- A member asks for a new HPS 250W Flood Light. The request does not meet the fixture condition: that legacy fixture is not installed new, whatever the account or member.
- A request for an LED 70W Area Light names a service account in a status other than active or idle. A light may not be requested on that account.
